report.summary: Prioritize fixing missing guard function (critical, blocks safety) and docstring contradictions (high, misleads). Then address bare variable access and floor-check bypass. Defer hidden missing fields pending definition of compare_to_history.
risks: If _refuse_primary_checkout is defined elsewhere, item 1 becomes no-op; verify first.
If compare_to_history does not exist, item 5 may need to be re-scoped.
Fixing docstrings without changing behavior may cause confusion if behavior is intentional.
todos: Before any edits, verify existence of _refuse_primary_checkout and full render_arms function.
After fixes, run full test suite to ensure no regressions.

items.title: Define or import _refuse_primary_checkout in correctness.py
items.why_now: Without it, _git_in_worktree raises NameError at runtime, breaking the safety check. This is a critical blocker.

steps.do: Search entire codebase for '_refuse_primary_checkout' definition. If missing, add a stub that raises NotImplementedError or implement the guard.
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'def _refuse_primary_checkout' daedalus/ returns a definition; and `python -c 'from daedalus.core.correctness import _refuse_primary_checkout'` succeeds.

items.assumption: The function is not defined elsewhere; if it is, this item is no-op.

items.title: Correct docstrings in drafts.py to accurately describe filesystem writes
items.why_now: False docstrings mislead developers and violate documentation integrity. High severity.

steps.do: Update module docstring to state that apply_payload writes to the filesystem via set_status. Remove 'writes nothing' claim.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'write_text' daedalus/kairos/drafts.py shows calls; docstring no longer claims no writes.

items.assumption: The writes are intentional and should be documented, not removed.

items.title: Fix bare variable access of 'by_provenance' in render_arms
items.why_now: If by_provenance is used as a bare name without definition, it causes NameError. Critical if present.

steps.do: Examine full render_arms function in report.py. If 'for prov in sorted(by_provenance):' exists without definition, change to 'for prov in sorted(result["by_provenance"]):'.
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'by_provenance' daedalus/eval/report.py shows only result['by_provenance'] usage.

items.assumption: The bug line exists; if not, this item is no-op.

items.title: Add floor_check call in ollama.py's run method
items.why_now: Without floor_check, secret checking can be bypassed if run() is called directly. High severity.

steps.do: Add call to floor_check (likely from session.py or a shared guard) at the beginning of ollama.run().
steps.verified_by: grep -n 'floor_check' daedalus/providers/ollama.py shows call; test that direct run triggers check.

items.assumption: floor_check is importable; its exact signature may need adjusting.

items.title: Verify compare_to_history inspects shape.truncated flag
items.why_now: If compare_to_history ignores truncated flag, missing fields may go unreported. Medium severity.

steps.do: Find definition of compare_to_history in codebase. If it exists, check if it inspects shape.truncated or notes. If not, add that check.
steps.verified_by: grep -rn 'def compare_to_history' daedalus/ finds definition; then grep for 'truncated' in that function.

items.assumption: compare_to_history exists and is defined in the codebase.
